scope: Read-only OpenWeatherMap five-day forecast fetch and in-memory parse for the candidate Kokonut Adelphi location.

data_handling.candidate_location_query: read-only transaction; latitude and longitude only

limitations: This was a host-run provider check using coordinates read from the candidate database; it does not exercise the candidate worker, signed worker identity, or ingestion path.
Forecast intervals were counted after successful parsing; no values or forecast timestamps were retained.
